This is essentially asystem for measurement of uplift pressures at the contacts of thestructures and the foundation soils.1.1.1 The principles, however, may also be applied to otherstructures (such as spillway aprons, head regulators, pump houseson lift channels and other appurtenant structures) resting onpermeable foundations, where uplift pressures and excessive exitgradients are likely to develop.2 ReferencesIS 2 :1960Rules for rounding offnumerical valuesIS 5050 : 1968Codeof practice for the design, construction andmaintenance of relief wells
